title_sq: Dyqan ne shitje buze rruge kryesore!
description_sq:
Dyqan ne shitje!
Shitet dyqan ne kryqezimin e Rr. "Fortuzi" me Rr. e "Durresit"!
Dyqani ndodhet ne nje pozicion shume te favorshem per ushtrimin e aktiviteteve te ndryshme, si noteri, agjensi udhetimesh, butik, servis paisjeve elektronike, pasticeri etj...
Dyqani ndodhet ne katin perdhe te nje objekti ekzistues me fasade buze rruges "Fortuzi", ka nje siperfaqe 100m2.
title_en: Shop for sale on the edge of the main street!
description_en: Shop for sale! Shop for sale at the intersection of Rr. "Fortuzi" with Rr. of "Durres"! The shop is located in a very favorable position for the exercise of various activities, such as notary, travel agency, boutique, electronic equipment service, pastry shop, etc... The shop is located on the ground floor of an existing building with facades on the edge of "Fortuzi" street, it has an area of ​​100m2.
